## Features

- Surface failures that need user action in the sidebar (8b8b778) in #3
- Ask for a new key when OpenCode Go rejects it (6ddb364) in #4

## Bug Fixes

- Read bar width from renderable for OpenTUI 0.6 (a897126) by @simonklee in #1
- Extend OpenAI profile grace period to 5 seconds (3df1726) in #2
- Hold usage fetched without its account profile (d7a6c12, 9095fd3) in #5

## New Contributors

- @simonklee made their first contribution in #1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejkang/opencode-ai-usage/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0

## Bug Fixes

- Fix empty usage bars on OpenCode v1 (de04a07)

## Dependencies

- Bump `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` to `^0.5.14` (aec222b)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejkang/opencode-ai-usage/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1
